_readme: Recall probe (COLLECTION.md §3), run 2026-09-26 after the grind. Sources independent of the base: the Wikipedia insource sweep (144 articles naming the firm, 28 already base rows, 15 company candidates), a Google News press sweep by year (2006-2026, four framings) and a denser sweep over Oct 2025-Sep 2026 (nine framings, 178 headlines), the UK register's officer graph (109 people, 139 seats; 76 seats at companies outside the base) with shareholder backtraces of the leads, the exit-side EDGAR full-text sweep (fts-hits.json), and a parametric enumeration of the firm's best-known positions by era. Every candidate lands as a base row with its evidence or as a recorded rejection with its reason.
